name: 17668-longdecode-deepseekv2lite16b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 (two GPUs of one a3 node, --gres=gpu:2, one in-process engine).
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: fine-grained sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, 64 routed experts with 6 active per token plus 2 shared, 15.7 B parameters, bf16, ~31.4 GB over 4 safetensors shards). The checkpoint declares its own config class, hence trust-remote-code.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 32 requests (3 warmup, 3 cooldown, 26 measured) with a 1800 s safety cap, static seed 17668.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 128 prompt tokens in and exactly 1024 tokens out with min == max == mean on both, `temperature: 0.0` (greedy), ignore_eos so all 1024 tokens are always generated.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant generating 1000-word replies from short prompts, one user at a time, on two GPUs.
launch:
# The served engine configuration.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Required: the checkpoint declares its own config class and transformers has no built-in
# `deepseek_v2` config, so AutoConfig cannot resolve it without this.
trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 2
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
enable-prefix-caching: false
